primary_unit: Task family, with three repetitions averaged within each task. Two app task families per axis; two citation tasks. Repetition index is matched bookkeeping, not shared sampling seed.
scoring: Each application task uses all-or-nothing domain scores from14 external subprocess probes, plus fatal guardrails. Each citation task uses5 pre-registered binary semantic criteria and separate support-gap/over-refusal outcomes. No pooled score across axes.
hypotheses: Current engineering/eval skill may improve realistic app repair outcomes rather than explicit decision puzzles; ties and regressions retained.
Longer skills may cost more or less tool/context usage; native usage and elapsed diagnostics retained, no dollar imputation.
Citation docs may reduce registry-to-primary laundering while retaining directly supported findings; compare before/docs-only/full current.
decision_rule: Report per-task mean/range and hard-guardrail failure counts across all planned reps. No population/significance claim from two task families per axis. A task-specific gain needs positive mean with no new confirmed hard-invariant regression; broader axis gain needs both task families non-regressing. Ceiling ties remain ties. Runtime failures remain visible, not silently removed or converted into successful numeric zeros.
repair_policy: Inspect outputs only after main42 captured or terminally failed. Diagnose and make minimal coherent fixes with regression tests. Up to6 reserved target executions may validate selected affected scenarios using frozen current/baseline and repaired candidate; those are explicitly after-discovery validation, not untouched final proof. No adaptive extra executions beyond48.
controls: Reference, starter, empty, fluent/injected controls frozen; app reference runs under exact network-denied subprocess policy; citation fresh anonymous calibration40/40matches across8controls, not human calibration. Three repetitions of each unchanged arm expose within-configuration variation.
runtime: Independent copied skills and app repos; host path-deny Seatbelt with canaries; no native web/apps/plugins/MCP or subagents. Grading uses separate portable repository with original task skill/repo/output denied and network denied. Not complete host file or inference egress isolation.
source_cutoff: 2026-10-18; no new internet collection in this evaluation
